question: What merit of all tīrtha bathing does one obtain by this?
premises: yenedaṃ sa tu refers to one who does this
sarvatīrthagamanasnānasya puṇyaṃ is merit of all tīrtha bathing
inference: One obtains the merit of bathing at all tīrthas by this.
plain_english: By this one obtains the merit of bathing at all tīrthas.
